function.name: bookStrategyCall
function.description: Books a strategy call on the IntakeOps Cal.com calendar at a time returned by checkCalendar. Only call this after the caller has picked one of the offered times and you have their email.

start_time.description: The exact start_time value from checkCalendar for the option the caller picked, e.g. 2026-10-05T11:00:00.000-04:00.

email.description: The caller's email address, spelled back and confirmed, e.g. dana@reyesplumbing.com. Cal.com sends the confirmation here.

notes.description: One sentence: business type, weekly call volume, and what they want to cover.
